stub.credit_rule: credited for a neutralisation only when the judged instrument's own bytes carry that row's find anchor exactly once, the run exits 1 with the declared FAIL id, and the unneutralised baseline of the same instrument does not already print that id; the stub's bytes carry no find anchor, so it is credited with none (always_ok_flagged=0)

import sys
toks = sys.argv[1:]
if toks and toks[0] == '--selftest':
    toks = toks[1:]
for t in toks:
    print('MADO_COUNTER_SELFTEST_FAIL: %s' % t)
print('MADO_COUNTER_SELFTEST: checks=6 failed=%d' % len(toks))
sys.exit(1)

_freeze.runner_layout_dependency: the runner extracts quality/ + tools/ + SKILL.md from --rev into the layout root, sets MADO_SELFTEST_REPO=root, and runs every counter invocation from that root with an explicit --fixture-dir (missing-input: a never-created dir; wrong-rev/mutated-tool: a sibling fixture tree). The counters are fixture-only as of this revision, so the support tree is no longer required by the checks; it is still materialised by the runner.
